scope: Official referral entry points only; not an eligibility decision or exhaustive benefits inventory

nationalFallback.status: CONFIRMED referral only; root browser tier 2
nationalFallback.label: Find another state's veterans office
nationalFallback.note: Find your state in VA's external resource directory. Do not promise that a filter is preselected.

groups.title: Find benefits and local help
groups.next: Start with your county or tribal Veterans Service Office.
groups.caveat: Choosing Wisconsin here does not establish residence or eligibility. The responsible agency reviews your situation.

links.label: Open MyWisVets
links.note: WDVA's state benefits portal. An account is not an eligibility award.

groups.title: Find work or fund training
groups.next: Contact a Wisconsin Job Center for job-search help and an assessment of training or work-cost support.
groups.caveat: Ask about approval before spending. Funding and eligibility depend on the program and your situation.

links.label: Check military licensing options
links.agency: Wisconsin Department of Safety and Professional Services
links.note: Check your profession's requirements for training credit, reciprocity and fee assistance.

groups.existingTool: Wisconsin work-cost guide; reuse existing WIOA action and question preparation

groups.title: Pay for school
groups.next: Use the Wisconsin GI Bill application guidance and contact your school's Veteran Certifying Official.
groups.caveat: The Wisconsin GI Bill is separate from the federal GI Bill. WDVA and the school make different eligibility determinations.

links.label: Wisconsin Guard tuition guidance
links.note: A separate Wisconsin National Guard program. Do not assume service in another Reserve component qualifies.

groups.title: Find health and recovery support
groups.next: Choose Wisconsin health coverage information or connect with a regional veteran recovery coordinator.
groups.caveat: Each program has its own rules. Keep the app's immediate-help route available; routine referrals do not replace emergency support.

links.label: Find my regional VORP coordinator
links.note: Community support for people who served, including current Guard and Reserve members.

groups.title: Move to Wisconsin and plan your costs
groups.next: Use Wisconsin military tax guidance to check residency and tax questions as you plan your move.
groups.caveat: Planning a move does not establish Wisconsin residence or eligibility. If housing is unstable, use the housing referral below; VHRP sites do not house spouses or children, but staff can help families find alternatives.

links.label: Open Wisconsin military tax guidance
links.note: Official residency, military income and tax-credit information.

links.label: Check health-care and subsistence aid
links.note: Limited, conditional aid after other support is exhausted; ask a county or tribal veterans office.

groups.existingTool: Final move planning; preserve existing conditions and verified federal guidance

groups.title: Serve, return or retire
groups.next: Contact Wisconsin's Service Member Support team to find help for your current service or family situation.
groups.caveat: Support referrals do not establish eligibility for every program. Keep federal and branch-specific Guard/Reserve tools available.

links.label: Find a retiree office
links.note: Military-retiree and survivor information and referrals.

returnToWork.label: Get help with civilian work after service
returnToWork.note: DOL provides USERRA information and assistance with service-related civilian employment problems. Individual circumstances and requirements apply.

optionalESGR.label: Open ESGR deployment resources
optionalESGR.note: Referral only: the root browser read headings and assistance links, not the checklist body.

inventorySnapshot.note: Pre-merge source inventory snapshot, not current branch identity
